name: Daily reading
how: Read long-form articles and editorials for 30 to 45 minutes daily; write a one-line summary of each

name: Mock analysis
how: Spend at least as long reviewing as taking the mock; review every wrong and every skipped question

name: Error log
how: Tag each mistake by topic and type (concept, calculation, reading, time); the next week targets the top 3 tags

name: Selective attempting
how: Scan all sets first; attempt the most doable ones; accuracy before attempts

name: Sectional timing practice
how: Practise each section in its fixed time to build pacing

name: Spaced formula review
how: Review on day 1, 3, 7 and 21 after learning

name: Mock interviews with feedback
how: Record answers; score against the interview rubric; redo weak answers

name: Semester-aware load
how: Lighter preparation in mid-sem and end-sem weeks, heavier in breaks
